shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
register-like horizontal division of the surface
repeated row of similar forms across the top
justification: Both are flat upright slabs bearing low relief with profile figures and a horizontal banded division, and both include a row of repeated similar forms along an upper zone (crouching creatures in B, the arcade-like row; fringe/hatching bands in A). But A depicts naturalistically proportioned clothed human figures with beards, robes, staff and dagger facing each other in an attendant scene, whereas B depicts schematic animals — a bird of prey, a quadruped, a crouching figure and a long-necked bird with a snake-like form — with no human interaction, so the specific content differs almost entirely.
